svg.text: Strokes = fingers · Bars = hands · Figures = bodies
A line through the bikú = "before Year 1" (negation, from trade debt notation)

svg.text: Black = carved glyph/stroke · Red = negation mark (for clarity) · Phonetic strokes shown in red in the example for illustration only
Base 5 (one hand) with base 20 (one body) grouping · Origin: finger and toe counting
Negation (line through bikú) adapted from trade debt notation — same mark used to indicate "owed" or "subtract"
Phonetics: 3 vowels + 9 consonants + glottal stop = 13 phonetic strokes · /g/ = open circle (voiced /k/) · /n/ = triple line (extended /m/)
